unit_note: USD millions. Department-level outlay lines from Table 3; each is standalone because this unit does not re-declare the full outlay roll-up (the sibling remainder unit holds the totals, and the department detail itself is Table 5's). Row COUNT is the check that matters here: strict coverage cannot see a missing standalone row.
